causalAutopsy.notes: Bug 1: PR #2163 (forward-to-holder, CMT-706 §4) emitted the delayed notice for every held send with no author check and no per-topic dedupe; background sends dominate on a standby. Bug 2 is latent: ensureAgentUpdatesTopic/ensureAgentAttentionTopic predate the read-only-standby guard; on a standby the create succeeded and state.set threw, so the id was never saved and the next boot created another. Agent Health lane id was in-memory only.

guardEvidence.howCaught: system-topic-adoption registered: adoption is idempotent (unchanged id = no write) and withAdoptionBrake caps re-adopts at 3 per kind per boot, so a flapping holder settles at boundK 9 / perTarget 3; the notice gate only suppresses an existing notify (once per topic per 6h cooldown)
